race.description: Jewell Builders Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: DAYLITE (8) was solid on debut over 1100m here last time out when closing nicely to end up 1.1L off the winner. McDougall rides now and out to 1200m won't be an issue with the way he finished off last time. Should be better for that run and he can get the job done this time. BOUJEE GOLD (9) got a mile back last start and never featured in the Black Opal before the break. She had shown something before that though and the form worked out well through the Golden Slipper. Blinkers go on now and it wouldn't surprise to see her fire on resumption. RIVER MERSEY (10) won a trial in good order at Moruya in readiness for this and maps to get every chance. Cole has been on board for both trials and sticks today. Can feature. HIGHWAY ROBBERY (3) comes back in trip today but continues to hint that he's got some talent. Include.
